result.Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan with modular architecture enabling data theft, surveillance, system manipulation, file/process management, browser and credential harvesting; uses multi-layered obfuscation including password-protected archives, steganography, base64 encoding, and multiple file drops to evade detection
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email impersonating Colombian government entity with malicious ZIP attachment containing BAT file that drops obfuscated VBS script, which downloads and executes further payloads
